sentences.text:
SR.PP.K.P.HARISH  THIS BAIL APPLICATION HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 11.06.2024, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 BA No. 216 of 2022 3  V.G.ARUN J.
 -------------------------------
 B.A.No.216 of 2022  --------------------------------
 Dated this the 11th day of June 2024  ORDER
The Bail Application is filed apprehending arrest in the complaint filed by the wife of the first petitioner alleging commission of the offence under Section 498A of IPC.
This matter has been pending with an interim direction from 11/01/2022 onwards.

If the Crime is registered only for the offence under Section 498A and the petitioners have so far not been questioned, the Investigating Officer will have to act in accordance with the directives of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Satender Kumar Antil v. CBI [(2022) 10 SCC 51] and issue notice under Section 41A of Cr.P.C.
The Bail Application is disposed of with the above observation.
Sd/-
